title: Open-closed localization for relative etale compact support
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Work in the bounded-below derived categories of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For any separated finite-type morphism $h:T\to B$ of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a compactification $c=(j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T,p:\overline T\to B)$ consists of a quasi-compact open immersion $j$ and a proper morphism $p$ with $h=pj$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]; write $Rh_!^c=Rp_*j_!$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be such a morphism, let $j_U:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion with closed complement $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], and put $g=fj_U$, $h=fi$. For every $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_h$ there is a distinguished triangle $Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K\to Rf_!^{c_f}K\to Rh_!^{c_h}i^{-1}K\to (Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K)[1]$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Its cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] fit in the exact sequence $\cdots\to\mathcal H^q(Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K)\to\mathcal H^q(Rf_!^{c_f}K)\to\mathcal H^q(Rh_!^{c_h}i^{-1}K)\to\mathcal H^{q+1}(Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K)\to\cdots$.

proof.text: First check the qcqs sources required by compact-support composition. Since $j_U$ is quasi-compact and $X$ is quasi-compact, $U$ is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](2). Affine opens of $U$ are affine opens of $X$, so both directions of [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-separated-affine-cover-criterion] show that $U$ is quasi-separated. By [def-weil-closed-immersion], $Z$ is homeomorphic to a closed subset of $X$, hence is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-in-quasi-compact]. For affine opens $V_a$ covering $X$, that definition also says that $i^{-1}V_a$ is affine. Its intersection with $i^{-1}V_b$ is a closed subset of the quasi-compact space $V_a\cap V_b$, and is therefore quasi-compact by the same lemma. The same affine-cover criterion shows that $Z$ is quasi-separated.

source.place: Tag 01KO, label lemma-characterize-quasi-separated; Tag 0GKP geometric hypotheses

proof.text: The hypothesis on $j_U$ and [lem-weil-pbc-qc-open-immersion-finite-type] give finite type of $j_U$. For an open-subscheme inclusion, two maps into $U$ with the same composite into $X$ agree, including their structure-sheaf maps. Thus $U\times_XU\cong U$, with diagonal inverse to either projection; the diagonal is an isomorphism and hence a closed immersion. This proves separatedness from [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence](e) makes $g=fj_U$ separated and locally of finite type. Since $U$ is quasi-compact and $Y$ is quasi-separated, [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1) makes $g$ quasi-compact; locally finite type plus quasi-compact is finite type by [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].

source.place: Tags 01T2 and 01T3, labels lemma-immersion-locally-finite-type and lemma-composition-finite-type; Schemes Tag 01KU, label lemma-separated-permanence

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper](a), $i$ is proper. By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite], it is finite, without any finite-generation assumption on its defining ideal. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-over-separated-finite-type] to $i$ followed by $f$: $h=fi$ is separated of finite type. Together with the preceding two steps, all the geometric hypotheses of the two later applications of compact-support composition are now verified.

source.place: Tags 01W5 and 035C, labels lemma-closed-immersion-proper and lemma-closed-immersion-finite; Tag 01T3, label lemma-composition-finite-type

proof.text: Apply [lem-cbc-open-closed-recollement] to $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$, $j_U:U\hookrightarrow X$, the given finite commutative ring and $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$. It supplies a distinguished triangle $A\xrightarrow{a}K\xrightarrow{b}C\xrightarrow{w}A[1]$ with $A=j_{U!}j_U^{-1}K$ and $C=i_*i^{-1}K$, where the closed direct image $i_*$ is exact. This is the absolute open-closed triangle of Tag 0GKL, obtained from the canonical sheaf short exact sequence of Tag 095L. Both functors in the displayed outer terms are the small-etale finite-ring functors of the statement, not exceptional inverse image or pro-etale operations.

source.place: Tags 0GKP and 0GKL, label lemma-triangle-associated-to-open; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 095L

proof.text: Write the chosen $c_f$ as $(j_f,p_f)$ and put $F=Rf_!^{c_f}=Rp_{f,*}j_{f!}$, as defined by [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. By [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact] and [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated], termwise $j_{f!}$ is triangulated and preserves a lower bound on degrees of a representing complex. The module-sheaf categories have enough injectives by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-enough-injectives]; $p_{f,*}$ is additive and left exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated] to these module categories, not merely to abelian sheaves: it gives the triangulated functor $Rp_{f,*}:D^+\to D^+$ with its natural shift comparison. Consequently the composite $F$ is triangulated. Applying it to step 4 gives $FA\xrightarrow{F(a)}FK\xrightarrow{F(b)}FC\xrightarrow{t}(FA)[1]$, where $t=\sigma_A F(w)$ and $\sigma_A:F(A[1])\cong(FA)[1]$ is the composite shift comparison.

source.place: Tag 0GKP, apply the triangulated compact-support functor; derived.tex Tags 015F, 05SE and 05SU

proof.text: Choose for $j_U$ the compactification $d_U=(j_U,\mathrm{id}_X)$ and for $i$ the compactification $d_Z=(\mathrm{id}_Z,i)$. The properness of $i$ was checked in steps 1–3. The identity is proper directly from the definitions in [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]: its diagonal is an isomorphism, its affine ring maps are identities of finite type, and all its base changes are identity closed maps. Both open factors are quasi-compact. The definition [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification] gives $R(j_U)_!^{d_U}=R(\mathrm{id}_X)_*j_{U!}\cong j_{U!}$ and $Ri_!^{d_Z}=Ri_*$. Identity direct image is identity, including on resolutions. Since $i_*$ is exact by [lem-cbc-open-closed-recollement], on a resolution $L\to I$ the map $i_*L\to i_*I$ is a quasi-isomorphism by [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated], giving $Ri_*\cong i_*$ on $D^+$. Now apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-qcqs-composition] to $U\xrightarrow{j_U}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$ with $d_U,c_f,c_g$, and to $Z\xrightarrow{i}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$ with $d_Z,c_f,c_h$. Steps 1–3 verified all qcqs and separated finite-type hypotheses. Evaluation gives isomorphisms $e_U:FA\cong Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K$ and $e_Z:FC\cong Rh_!^{c_h}i^{-1}K$. Set $G=Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K$, $H=Rh_!^{c_h}i^{-1}K$. The required arrows are $F(a)e_U^{-1}:G\to FK$, $e_ZF(b):FK\to H$, and $e_U[1]t e_Z^{-1}:H\to G[1]$. Thus $(e_U,\mathrm{id}_{FK},e_Z)$ is an isomorphism from the triangle in step 5 to this triangle. By TR1 in [def-weil-triangulated-category] it is distinguished. This proves existence for the three specified compactifications; no unjustified assertion that arbitrary chosen compactifications fit in a Cartesian triangle is used.

source.place: Tag 0GKP, identifications by composition (0F7J) and the immersion specializations of 0GKM

proof.text: The category of small-etale $\Lambda$-module sheaves on $Y$ is abelian by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-grothendieck-abelian]. Apply [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] to the distinguished triangle of step 6 in its derived category. By [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the bounded-below derived category is a strictly full triangulated subcategory of that category, so the same cohomology functors give the exact sequence at every integer $q$. Its connecting morphism is the one induced by $e_U[1]t e_Z^{-1}$, followed by the cohomology-shift identification $\mathcal H^q(G[1])\cong\mathcal H^{q+1}(G)$. By [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], these cohomology objects are the cohomology sheaves in the statement. This is exactly the displayed sequence, including exactness at all three positions and every connecting map.

Step 1 proves U and Z qcqs from qcqs-permanence(2), both clauses of the affine-cover criterion and closed-in-quasi-compact; V_a∩V_b is never assumed affine. Step 2 gives j_U finite type from the qc-open-immersion leaf, writes out the open-immersion diagonal (elementary), gets g separated and LFT from proper-fp-permanence(e), and g quasi-compact from permanence(1) since Y is quasi-separated. These are all Mathlib leaves or definitions, so they are tools, not route. Steps 4-7 are unchanged. The compactifications d_U=(j_U,id) and d_Z=(id,i) are valid, Ri_*≅i_* follows from exactness, the triangle-isomorphism squares commute so TR1 applies, and D^+ is a full triangulated subcategory, which gives the LES at every q.
